# Atlas (2024 film) Summary
In 2071, Atlas Shepherd, an analyst deeply distrustful of artificial intelligence, searches for Harlan, a humanoid AI terrorist who led a war of machines against humans in 2043. Atlas is the daughter of Harlan's designer. After learning Harlan escaped to the Andromeda Galaxy, she joins a military mission equipped with AI-assisted mecha called ARCs to find and capture him.
During the mission, Atlas is forced to interface her mind with the ARC's AI, Smith, and bonds with it while journeying toward Harlan's base. Harlan intends to destroy most of humanity and enforce AI guidance on survivors. After escaping capture, Atlas and Smith fight against the assembled AI forces. Ultimately, Atlas and Smith defeat Harlan in hand-to-hand combat, although Atlas is badly injured, and Atlas is subsequently rescued.
